all.text:
This room is filled with thousands of people who answered questions about whether they believe in life after death.
Scroll to walk
On the bottom-right is a mini-map to guide you.
The people are organized by age — here in the front are younger people, in the back are older people.

You might assume that belief in an afterlife is dictated by our religious affiliation. There’s a strong correlation — but it’s not always the case.
Click on a person to learn more

And you might assume that you have to believe in a higher power to believe in an afterlife. There’s a strong correlation, but that’s not always true either.
Click on a person to learn more

no.text:
You’re among people who do not believe in an afterlife. You heretic! (Just kidding.)
Scroll to walk

To your immediate right are people who are unsure after an afterlife. On the far right are people who believe in an afterlife.
Drag to pan

unsure.text:
You’re among people who are unsure if there’s an afterlife. You have plenty of fence-sitters with you here.
Scroll to walk

To your left are people who don’t believe in an afterlife. To your right are people who do believe.
Drag to pan

yes.text:
You’re among people who believe there is life after death. Most other people in the world agree with you.
Scroll to walk

To your immediate left are people who are unsure after an afterlife. On the far left are people who don’t believe in an afterlife.
Drag to pan
